nyc-buildings.title: NYC Buildings 3D
nyc-buildings.summary: An interactive 3D visualisation of New York's building stock in the browser. Raw data is cleaned, extruded and rendered as a performant scene.
nyc-buildings.outcome: Coursework for Information Visualisation, later extended with a view of Amberg.

nothing-deck.title: Presentation design system
nothing-deck.summary: A consistent slide design built on LaTeX: dark ground, dot grid, monospaced type and a tightly defined accent palette.
nothing-deck.outcome: A reusable template instead of one-off slides — layout rules defined once, then only content.

about.title: About
body: I study at OTH Amberg-Weiden and spend most of my time where data meets design: information visualisation, frontend development and everything in between.
What interests me is the work behind the visible result — clean data pipelines, consistent design systems, tools that make the next step faster. A project is only finished once it also feels right.
I'm currently looking for projects where I can bring both to the table: technical execution and design standards.
